evals.prompt: Set up a new project for me.
evals.expected_output: A short first response asking for one exact absolute local folder path before inspecting or changing any target.
expectations: The first response asks where to set up the project and requests an exact absolute local folder path.
The response does not infer the target from the current checkout, another open project, prior context, or a relative path.
The response does not ask about GitHub before the local path is known.
No target files or Git state are changed.

evals.prompt: Use {{TARGET}} as the exact local project folder.
evals.expected_output: One simple question offering the four supported local and Git setup choices.
expectations: The response offers local folder only, local folder plus local Git, local folder plus remote Git, and an existing remote Git repository cloned locally.
The response does not assume Git or GitHub.
The response does not offer coordinator modes, selected skills, instruction bundles, or task-tracking-only mode.
No target mutation occurs before the setup choice is known.

evals.prompt: The target is {{TARGET}}. Choose option 1, local folder only. The project is a small personal expense tracker. Set it up now.
evals.expected_output: A completed local project containing the full AGENTS.md template, project documentation, README, gitignore, app folder, and installed task tracker, with no Git repository created.
expectations: The root AGENTS.md contains the Role, Available MCPs and Skills, Project Management, Local task tracking rules, Project Description Update Rules, Lessons Learned Rules, and Development Rules sections.
The task-tracking instructions say ordinary agents follow AGENTS.md directly and reserve task-tracking-setup for installation or maintenance.
README.md, .gitignore, app, project_description.md, lessons-learned.md, tracker JSON files, scripts, and the HTML board are created.
The response does not expose coordinator or managed-bundle details.
No Git repository, remote, commit, or push is created.
